text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Summer camp was so much fun~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Training was tougher and harder than 
usual, but—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why I can truly feel 
that I've grown, and it makes me so 
happy!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If she continues to grow like this, she 
should be able to achieve great results in 
the Japan Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Please don't hold back on the strict 
guidance even when we get back to the 
academy, Trainer!
